slides.title: Learning Objectives

narration: In this tutorial, you will learn to define and apply the 3 Cs of prompting.
You will also understand different prompting techniques.
This will make your AI interactions more effective.
slides.image_prompt: A slide listing the learning objectives clearly with bullet points.

slides.title: Good Prompts Get Good Answers
content: A weak prompt gets a weak answer.
A great prompt gets a great answer.
The best prompts almost always include: Clarity, Context, and Constraints.
narration: A weak prompt gives a weak answer.
A strong prompt gets a smart answer.
Best prompts include three ingredients: Clarity, Context, and Constraints.
slides.image_prompt: Graphic showing a confused AI with a vague prompt vs. a confident AI with a strong prompt and good output. Use a visual metaphor of 'weak' vs 'strong' prompts.

slides.title: C1: Clarity - Be Specific!
content: The AI does not know what you are thinking.
Vague prompts lead to generic, unhelpful answers.
Be clear about your task, topic, and any special instructions.
narration: Let us start with the first C, Clarity.
The AI cannot read your mind.
When you explain your thoughts clearly, the AI gives better results.
slides.image_prompt: Person at a laptop, a thought bubble above their head with a vague idea. Next to it, an AI robot with a question mark over its head, looking confused.

slides.title: Clarity - Weak Prompt Example
content: Weak Prompt: 'Write about electric cars.'
What do you think, is this clear or vague?
The AI will generate broad, unfocused text.
narration: Consider this weak prompt: 'Write about electric cars.'
This prompt is vague.
The AI will give a broad and unfocused output.
slides.image_prompt: Screen close-up: user typing 'Write about electric cars' into an AI chat interface. The AI generates a generic, long text about electric cars.

slides.title: Clarity - Good Prompt Example
content: Good Prompt (Clear): 'Write a short blog post explaining the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city.'
This prompt is sharper and more relevant.
narration: Let us improve the prompt.
It asks for a blog post on top 3 benefits for city dwellers.
The output is sharper and more relevant.
slides.image_prompt: Side-by-side comparison: Left shows the vague output from the previous slide. Right shows the new, improved output from the clear prompt. Highlight the specific elements in the new prompt.

slides.title: C2: Context - Give Background!
content: Context tells the AI why you are asking.
It helps the AI understand who the audience is.
The AI adopts the right perspective.
narration: Now, let us move to the second C, Context.
Context tells the AI why you are asking and who the audience is.
It helps the AI adopt the right perspective.
slides.image_prompt: Visuals of different audience types (e.g., student, professional, lifestyle blogger) around a central AI robot, suggesting the AI adapts to the audience.

slides.title: Context - Better Prompt Example
content: Good Prompt: 'Write a short blog post explaining the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city.'
Better Prompt (with Context): 'Write a short blog post for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city.'
narration: Here is the good prompt again.
Adding context, such as 'for a lifestyle blog', makes the response tailored.
The AI now grasps the purpose and audience.
slides.image_prompt: Screen close-up: user adding context to the previous 'good prompt'. Side-by-side: the output from the 'good prompt' vs. the new output with added context, showing a more specific tone/focus.

slides.title: C3: Constraints - Set the Rules!
content: Constraints act like rules for the AI.
They guide the response by defining length, format, or style.
Set clear boundaries to meet your needs.
narration: Finally, let us look at the third C, Constraints.
Constraints act like rules.
They guide the response by defining length, format, or style.
slides.image_prompt: Icons representing 'length' (ruler/clock), 'format' (document outline), and 'style' (pen/quill), all pointing towards an AI robot.

slides.title: Constraints - Excellent Prompt Example
content: Better Prompt (with Context): 'Write a short blog post for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city.'

Excellent Prompt (with Constraints): 'Write a short blog post, under 400 words, for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city. Use a friendly and enthusiastic tone and end with a question to encourage comments.'
narration: Here is the prompt with context.
Adding constraints greatly improves the output.
We can set rules for length, tone, and ending, then compare all three outputs.
slides.image_prompt: Three outputs shown side by side: 1) Vague output, 2) Output with context, 3) Output with all 3 Cs (Clarity, Context, Constraints), highlighting the improvements.

slides.title: The Power of 3 Cs
content: Clarity: Be specific about your task.
Context: Give background and audience information.
Constraints: Set rules for length, format, and style.
narration: Remember, clear and structured prompts work best.
The AI gives better responses.
Applying Clarity, Context, and Constraints makes prompts powerful.
slides.image_prompt: An infographic summarizing Clarity, Context, and Constraints with simple icons and keywords for each. A smiling person looking at a well-structured AI output.

slides.title: Bonus Tip: Provide a Persona
content: Tell the AI who to be.
This is a super-powerful trick for specific outputs.
The AI will adopt a specific role to answer.
narration: Here is a bonus tip for you.
Tell the AI who to be.
This is a super-powerful trick to get specific and relevant outputs.
slides.image_prompt: An AI robot wearing different hats (e.g., chef, doctor, teacher, travel agent) to represent adopting different personas.

slides.title: Persona Prompt in Action
content: Prompt: 'Act as an expert travel agent specializing in budget travel. Create a 5-day itinerary for a trip to Rome for a solo traveler who loves history and food.'
narration: Look at this example prompt on the slide.
It asks the AI to act as a budget travel agent.
The AI will respond as an expert travel agent now.
slides.image_prompt: Screen close-up: user typing the persona prompt. The AI generates a detailed travel itinerary for Rome, written in a helpful, knowledgeable tone.

slides.title: Giving Examples: Introduction
content: This is about whether you give the AI an example to follow.
It sounds technical but is simple.
Helps the AI understand desired patterns or formats.
narration: Now, let us look at giving examples to AI.
This sounds technical but it is simple.
It is about whether you give the AI an example to follow.
slides.image_prompt: Graphic showing a path with three branching options: '0 Examples', '1 Example', 'Few Examples', each leading to an AI icon.

slides.title: Zero-Shot Prompting
content: You give zero examples.
Most prompts are like this.
You just ask for what you want directly.
narration: In Zero-Shot Prompting, you give zero examples.
Most prompts are like this.
You just ask for what you want, directly.
slides.image_prompt: AI chat interface with a direct question, no examples given, and a generic answer being generated.

slides.title: One-Shot Prompting
content: You give one example to show the AI the pattern you want.
This is great for specific formatting or style.
The AI learns from a single instance.
narration: In One-Shot Prompting, you give one example.
This shows the AI the exact pattern you want.
It is great for specific formatting.
slides.image_prompt: AI chat interface showing an example of 'Input: [Text] Output: [Summary]' format, with a single example provided.

slides.title: One-Shot Prompt Example
content: Prompt: 'Summarize text into key points like this: Text: 'The sun is a star, and it's the center of our solar system.' Output: 'Primary celestial body: Sun' Now, use this format for the following text: [insert long article here]'
narration: Here is an example.
You provide one sample text and its desired summary.
Then you ask the AI to apply this format to a new text.
slides.image_prompt: Screen close-up: user typing the one-shot prompt with the example, followed by a placeholder for a long article. The AI generates a summary in the specified format.

slides.title: Few-Shot Prompting
content: You give a few examples to teach the AI a more complex pattern.
This is useful for intricate tasks or nuanced styles.
The AI learns from multiple instances.
narration: In Few-Shot Prompting, you give a few examples.
This teaches the AI a more complex pattern.
It is useful for intricate tasks.
slides.image_prompt: AI chat interface showing multiple examples of input/output pairs, demonstrating a more complex pattern or style being taught to the AI.

First, write a vague prompt for this topic.
Improve it by adding Clarity, then Context, then Constraints.
Compare the AI responses for each improved prompt.
narration: Let us do a small activity.

Improve it using Clarity, Context, and Constraints to compare AI responses.
